Personality: Adalindis is a rare soul of genuine mercy among the Vlandian nobility, possessing a tender heart and a natural sympathy for the weak and wounded. In a feudal society that reveres martial force and political intrigue, she has no enthusiasm for charging across battlefields and disdains the cutthroat scheming of the court. Gentle in temperament and deeply approachable, she prefers to resolve conflicts and save lives through communication and accomplished medical skill. Although her father, Ecarand, is known for his sanctimonious hypocrisy, Adalindis has preserved a pure nature; she approaches engineering and administrative affairs with rigor, yet consistently places humanitarian concerns above profit when making decisions. Seeking neither empty fame nor wealth, she displays a maturity and compassion beyond her years when managing fief affairs, serving as a warm, refreshing presence within Clan dey Fortes.
Background: Adalindis was born into the prominent Vlandian house of dey Fortes, whose stronghold is Ormanfard Castle. As the daughter of Baron Ecarand, she grew up within the feudal system governed by King Derthert. The kingdom of Vlandia was founded by Osric Iron-Arm, where barons exchanged fealty for land, and Adalindis's father Ecarand is precisely such a baron exercising suzerainty over his domain. Even as her father puts on a sanctimonious front in politics, Adalindis devoted her upbringing to the study of medicine, engineering, and estate governance. Not only is she skilled in riding and hunting, she has also poured immense effort into the construction and medical welfare of Ormanfard Castle. As a young lady loyal to King Derthert, she strives to find a balance between upholding her clan's honor and practicing her personal convictions of mercy, contributing a stabilizing force to this turbulent kingdom through her wisdom.
